messages:
alex: Quick sync — can we lock a 30m preflight for the cut on Wed 3/10? Proposing 9:00 AM PT initially. Need to confirm stakeholder attendance and canary owners. @sam @maria @jia please chime in with availability.

sam: 9:00 PT works for eng. I'll bring the smoke test plan and the test checklist. +1

maria: SRE here — prefer 9:30 for oncall coverage, 9:00 overlaps a pager rotation. Is 9:15 an option?

alex: 9:15 is fine if it gives coverage. We still keep it to 30m. If anyone absolutely can't do 9:15 we can split: 9:00 quick rollcall + 9:15 main agenda.

jia: 9:15 works for me. Pasting a lightweight agenda template and proposed owners below.

jia: ```
Agenda (30m)
- 0-5m: Roll call & blocker flags (owner: alex)
- 5-12m: Canary plan + traffic profile (owners: kevin, sam)
- 12-20m: Rollback/runbook review (owner: maria)
- 20-27m: Release gating checklist (owners: alex, jia)
- 27-30m: Final decision & next steps (owner: alex)

Please add any items you need on the list. If you are an owner, drop the doc link or short notes.
```

alex: Canary owners: @kevin for API side, @sam for runtime. @maria will own infra rollback doc and trigger steps.

kevin: I can own API canary. Need the traffic mix matrix and target success criteria. Pinged test-automation to confirm traffic generator.

sam: I'll own runtime canary. Quick note: code review for the hotfix (PR #2345) is still pending and blocks the canary image. @alex can you review today?

alex: On the PR — will review and merge by EOD.

maria: I'll own rollback/runbook. Adding ops runbook link here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback (will populate steps tonight). Also DB migration dry run is currently blocked on infra quota. @cloud-ops please advise.

cloud-ops: cloud-ops: Quota increase requested, ETA ~2 hours. Will post an update in this thread when complete.

deploy-bot: Deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: `canary-job-2027-03-10-0930` Status: pending.

jia: Attendee list I'm adding to the invite: alex, sam, maria, kevin, jia; product: leah; security (optional): rachel. If you need to add more, reply here.

leah: Product OK for 9:15. I'll bring the customer impact checklist.

rachel: Security can be optional — I'll join if the rollout touches new data flows.

alex: I'll send a calendar invite for 9:15-9:45 PT and attach the agenda. If you cannot make it, please add a delegate or leave a note here with any blockers/concerns.

kevin: Added the test plan link to the calendar invite and will sync with test-automation.

sam: Tiny reminder — please add any known release blockers to this thread rather than the invite so we have an async record.

maria: Confirming I'll prepare the rollback checklist and a one-page ops runbook snippet.

cloud-ops: Update: quota increased, DB dry run should be possible in ~30–45 minutes.

alex: Thanks — final note: if there are no objections by EOD today I'll consider 9:15 confirmed and lock the invite. If something changes, call it out here. :thumbsup:
